activities.summary: Sourced from CMA Lebanon register and pitchbook/cfi.co profiles. Genuine family-office/HNW wealth-management fit. Leadership attribution conflicts between two sources (Fadi Assali vs Raed Khoury) and was not reconciled. Being an investment bank rather than a deposit-taking commercial bank may reduce (not eliminate) exposure to the Law 23/2025 resolution question - inference, not confirmed.

description: Boutique Lebanese investment bank founded in Beirut in 2011, focused on wealth management, capital markets and investment banking (M&A advisory, fundraising) for high-net-worth individuals, family offices and corporates across MENA. A licensed investment bank rather than a deposit-taking retail bank, which may place it differently relative to the commercial-bank resolution framework, though this is not confirmed. Listed on CMA Lebanon's approved-institutions register. Leadership named in sources as Chairman-General Manager, with some conflicting attribution between co-founders Fadi Assali (named in a 2017 profile) and Raed Khoury (named in a more recent Craft.co listing) - current incumbent not independently reconciled.

fit.reasoning: Fit: priority segment private/investment bank serving family offices and HNWIs (20) + Lebanon (15) + multi-asset (wealth mgmt, capital markets, corporate finance) (10) + explicitly manages third-party/client capital, not proprietary (10) + BDL/CMA regulated (5) = 60/60 - a strong structural fit, closer to our family-office/HNW pitch than a mass retail bank. Timing: sector-wide pressure (10/25); being an investment bank rather than a deposit-heavy commercial bank may mean lighter exposure to the FX-deposit/correspondent-banking crisis at the core of Law 23/2025, but this is inference, not a confirmed fact, so it is not scored as a positive trigger - Andre should treat the resolution-track question as open here too. Access: named leadership exists but is unreconciled between two conflicting sources = 3/15 (uncertain named contact). Total mechanically ~73, held to 55 given the leadership-name conflict needs resolving and the resolution-track question, though this is one of the more promising non-mass-retail names in the batch.
